candidates.transcript_evidence: And so now kind of evaluating the impact of these policies, what other policies or incentives do you think could complement the current initiative to further promote electric vehicle adoption?
candidates.description: 询问在评估政策影响的基础上，哪些其他政策或激励措施可以补充当前举措以促进电动汽车采用

limitations: 转录中仅有两个语义单元：一个问句和一个简短肯定回复，未包含更多候选
